senses.gloss: הִשְׂמְאִיל (b. h.) to go to the left; to be on the left side, go wrong.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 63a:18">Sabb. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>למַשְׂמְאִילִים בה</he> to those who make the wrong use of it, v. <cite ref="J00419"><he>יָמַן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 88b:4">Ib. 88ᵇ</cite> <he>למשמאילים בה</he> (Ms. M. <he>דלא איימין ליה</he>, v. <he>וְמַן</he>).

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:9:1">Cant. R. to I, 9</cite> <he>אלו … ואלו משמאילים</he> those (pleading in favor of the accused) stand to the right, and those (against the accused) to the left; a. e.
